blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. left Shenzhen on Friday after his participation at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting (AELM) and several bilateral talks with world leaders. The aircraft carrying the Philippine delegation departed from the Shenzhen Bao’an International Airport at around 4 p.m. READ: Xi personally welcomes Marcos at 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting In his intervention at the AELM, Marcos called for stronger cooperation in sustainable fisheries, healthcare, and in preparing economies for changing demographics.
